title: SecurityMeasure
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — security of processing measures under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Article 32 requires controllers and processors to implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, including pseudonymisation, encryption, CIA, resilience, and regular testing. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Article 32.

securityMeasuresImplemented.description: Whether appropriate technical and organisational security measures have been implemented, taking into account the state of the art, costs of implementation, nature/scope/context/purposes of processing, and risk. Source: GDPR Art 32(1).

pseudonymisationApplied.description: Whether pseudonymisation of personal data is applied where appropriate. Source: GDPR Art 32(1)(a).

encryptionApplied.description: Whether encryption of personal data is applied where appropriate. Source: GDPR Art 32(1)(a).

confidentialityEnsured.description: Whether the ability to ensure the ongoing confidentiality of processing systems and services is in place. Source: GDPR Art 32(1)(b).

integrityEnsured.description: Whether the ability to ensure the ongoing integrity of processing systems and services is in place. Source: GDPR Art 32(1)(b).

availabilityEnsured.description: Whether the ability to ensure the ongoing availability of processing systems and services is in place. Source: GDPR Art 32(1)(b).

resilienceEnsured.description: Whether the ability to ensure the ongoing resilience of processing systems and services is in place. Source: GDPR Art 32(1)(b).

timelyRestorationCapable.description: Whether the ability to restore the availability and access to personal data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident is in place. Source: GDPR Art 32(1)(c).

regularTestingPerformed.description: Whether a process for regularly testing, assessing and evaluating the effectiveness of technical and organisational measures for ensuring the security of the processing is in place. Source: GDPR Art 32(1)(d).

riskAssessmentPerformed.description: Whether risks presented by processing (in particular from accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure of, or access to personal data) have been assessed. Source: GDPR Art 32(2).

personnelAuthorisationEnforced.description: Whether steps have been taken to ensure that any natural person acting under the authority of the controller or processor who has access to personal data does not process them except on instructions from the controller. Source: GDPR Art 32(4).
